digest.component_or_area: LLM agent tool execution and step limiting
propositions: tool_step_limit implemented via filtered() omits toolConfig from requests when filter trips after tool calls, violating Bedrock/Anthropic protocol constraint that toolConfig must accompany toolUse history, causing 400 ValidationException
current mechanism converts convergence boundary cutoff into provider error which interpret_failure sweeps into LLMUnavailableError, affecting all armed sites and bounded-recovery fallback

proposed solution replaces hidden-tools mechanism with WrapperToolset steering wrapper that returns fixed notice instead of executing tools past limit, keeping tool definitions advertised and requests protocol-valid
steering is advisory and terminal bound is existing UsageLimits budget (request_limit, tool_calls_limit); model ignoring steering exhausts budget and raises UsageLimitExceeded
FunctionModel tests miss provider constraint because FunctionModel accepts tools-less requests over tool_use history, unrepresentable offline without live Bedrock/Anthropic testing
LIVE-proven end-to-end: tool-happy agent landed after 3 real + 7 steered calls and structured completion_verdict after 4 real + 2 steered calls on Bedrock us-east-1
